title: One account standing from the record and billing
assertion: `standingKind` and `accountStanding` give good only for an active record in good billing standing; a suspended record reads "Suspended by PaidWhole" whatever billing's standing, with no date, a support ticket (`/support?from=billing`) as its next step and the note that changing the plan or payment method does not lift it; a closed record reads "Closed" whatever else, takes no new plan (the plan route refuses it before Stripe is asked) and offers the ticket to reopen it; an active record suspended for nonpayment names billing's date and the invoice holding it (`billing_standing.invoice_id`, even past the newest 24), and says a card payment restarts runs at once and a bank (ACH) payment once the bank settles it; past due names its date and the day runs stop; beside a suspension or closure, an unpaid invoice is named with what it holds and paying it is a second step; a firm is never told runs have stopped or will, and its unpaid invoice reads past due; every non-good standing has a notice and a next step; the page draws one badge from the label, one alert and one `data-standing`, with no second date; the console shows and orders by the same kind
noFileReason: accountStanding and standingKind are pure functions of values the test passes in memory, and the routes read synthetic organizations; no file.
